Name: Fat Pony
Author: ChemiKhazi
Description:
A horse replacement based on Kate Beaton's [url=http://www.harkavagrant.com/index.php?id=130]Fat Pony[/url] character. The default horse looked almost like riding the ridiculous fat pony so I decided it must be so.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sHgGvGL.gif[/img]

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Open your Stardew Valley folder. In Steam, this is [ [font=Courier New]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\ ][/font]

[*]Navigate to the subdirectory [ [font=Courier New]Content\Animals[/font] ]

[*]Optional: back up the file, horse.xnb

[*]Extract horse.xnb from the zip file, and place it inside [ [font=Courier New]Content\Animals[/font] ]

[/list]
